recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13940; future changes should come from a new decision about broader reverse value-set lookup behavior or terminology-server guidance, not from this already-applied tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-13940 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request asking for ValueSet?code search so implementers can find reusable value sets containing a code, with server support and limits declared in TerminologyCapabilities for definitions, expansions, or both.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn/git import commit 6826aa32162838368e2e38376119ff0b90e35b95 (#13940, svn r12750), which added ValueSet search notes, TerminologyCapabilities.codeSearch material, and the original ValueSet code search parameter to the old spreadsheet source. Commit e0f69bc5cb8aa9ec01633efea90d88bacb2f8ef3 immediately corrected the expression to select expansion codes, and the 2021 source rework carried the capability into the current XML bundle and StructureDefinition sources.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes ValueSet and TerminologyCapabilities. Later FHIR-17792 clarified the CodeSearchSupport values used by TerminologyCapabilities and is already represented on the combined branch. Later FHIR-49784 updated ValueSet-code to use repeat(contains), preserving the seed behavior for nested expansion contents. Community searches found no conflicting FHIR-13940-specific Zulip or Confluence record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/valueset/bundle-ValueSet-search-params.xml defines ValueSet-code over ValueSet.expansion.repeat(contains).code and ValueSet.compose.include.concept.code; source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml documents the expensive/context-dependent nature of the search and points to TerminologyCapabilities; TerminologyCapabilities.codeSearch is bound to CodeSearchSupport values for in-compose, in-expansion, and in-compose-or-expansion.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Vocabulary issue clarified/replaced the CodeSearchSupport values used to declare the same ValueSet code search capability; it already has an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit on the combined branch.
Later Applied nested-search-parameter issue changed ValueSet-code to use repeat(contains) so nested expansion codes are included.
